functions.handle_webhook: Reworked: logs every event to WebhookLog before dispatch (school resolved from payload metadata/payment/invoice), dispatches charge.success -> confirm w/ tamper check, charge.* failures -> FAILED if PENDING, unhandled -> ignored. All inside one atomic block. Idempotency via CONFIRMED+webhook_processed flag.
functions.initiate_payment: BASE_URL now settings.PAYSTACK_BASE_URL w/ fallback; new row sets initiated_at; after successful API response persists authorization_url + access_code + initiated_at via QuerySet.update (both new-row and existing_reference reuse paths); metadata adds custom_fields invoice field. PENDING-row-before-API, kobo conversion, timeout=15, error dict unchanged.
functions.verify_transaction: NEW - GET {base}/transaction/verify/{reference}, same headers, timeout=15; returns full response dict on success, {'error': message|'Verification failed'} on non-200/status false, {'error': 'Payment gateway error. Please try again.'} on exception.
functions.issue_receipt: NEW - FeeReceipt get_or_create(payment=...) defaults school + 'RCP-{year}-{pk:06d}'; lazy import; called inside atomic block on both confirm paths (idempotent).
functions._handle_charge_success: NEW helper - already-confirmed short-circuit, TAMPER CHECK (int(payment.amount*100) != amount_kobo -> FAILED + webhook_processed + warning, NO credit), confirm path sets status/paid_on/webhook_processed/webhook_payload/verified_at/currency/fees_charged/channel/card_last4/card_brand/bank_name/paid_by_email/paid_by_name/paid_by_phone; webhook-first fallback creates CONFIRMED payment with enrichment; receipt + log processed on both.
functions._handle_charge_failure: NEW helper - charge.failed/error/other charge.*: PENDING payment -> FAILED + webhook_processed + payload; returns 'recorded'; else 'ignored'.
functions._create_webhook_log/_resolve_event_schoo: NEW private helpers (school resolution required for non-null TenantScopedModel.school FK; getattr fallbacks since settings.py on disk lacks PAYSTACK_BASE_URL/DEFAULT_CURRENCY).

tamper_check_position: handle_webhook charge.success, immediately after already-confirmed short-circuit, before any credit; mismatch -> status=FAILED, webhook_processed=True, webhook_payload=event, save(update_fields=[status, webhook_processed, webhook_payload]), logger.warning, JsonResponse({'status': 'amount mismatch'}) 200, no receipt.
idempotency_flags: webhook_processed=True set on confirm/fail; 'already confirmed' requires status==CONFIRMED AND webhook_processed; WebhookLog rows: processed=True for fully-handled events, False for ignored/unhandled/error routes.
receipt_issuance: issue_receipt(payment) called inside atomic block whenever a payment is confirmed (both existing-row and webhook-first paths); get_or_create -> idempotent; lazy import fee receipt model.
decimal_only: No float usage anywhere in file (Decimal only, kobo via int(Decimal*100)); float-scanner test passes.
next_steps: optionally define PAYSTACK_BASE_URL and DEFAULT_CURRENCY in school/settings.py (module already handles absence via getattr)
